title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations version 4.171.3551.6 release
body:
We are announcing the availability of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Project Operations version 4.171.3551.6. This version began deploying for general availability on September 21, 2026.

The deployment will follow a station-wide schedule, based on the geographical region where your environment is provisioned. You can find your station and region details at Project Operations Updates.

How does this affect me?
There is no expected impact to service performance or availability during the maintenance window.

For more information on new features and detailed release notes please visit What's new or changed in Project Operations.

What action do I need to take?
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

We recommend testing the new version in your sandbox environments using the Self Update option. If any issues arise, please contact Microsoft Support.
